blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 135 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 18, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DCBO & MTD lead 135 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 48 Canadian and 87 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 18, 2026) found 135 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 48 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 26 of them new to the list this week. Docebo Inc. (DCBO) leads with a +94% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 9 names.

In the U.S., 87 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 11 of them new to the list this week. Mettler-Toledo International Inc. (MTD) leads with a +56% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 25 names.
